_comment: U.S. DOT & federal live-camera pack — batch 1 of an assisted web-research harvest (2026-08-26).
_provenance: Compiled from official state DOT / 511 traveler-information systems (DelDOT, MoDOT, WisDOT, Nevada DOT, Louisiana DOTD, GDOT, ADOT, Alaska DOT&PF, NCDOT DriveNC, Oregon TripCheck) plus one NPS webcam. Media URLs follow each system's published streaming pattern; per-entry liveness was checked during research (see license notes) but streams rotate — the app's per-camera health chips and bounded reconnects handle any that go dark. Coordinates come from provider metadata except entries marked posEstimated. Batch 2 (2026-08-26) adds 13 Maryland CHART cameras as page-linked markers: the research batch supplied provider coordinates but no per-camera stream URLs, so they were downgraded from the claimed 'hls' rather than shipped broken. Batch 4 (2026-08-27) adds 21 NPS park webcams (Yellowstone, Glacier, Mount Rainier, Yosemite, Great Smoky Mountains) as page-linked entries with per-camera nps.gov webcam pages; the Old Faithful row claimed 'hls' without a stream URL and was downgraded per the url-less rule.
_behavior: HLS entries play in-app (projection plane + panel player); page-only entries expose ACCESS LIVE FEED to the operator's own map/player. Disable this pack with CCTV_USDOT_ENABLED=0.
